verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI explicitly markets natural-language editing/debugging across large codebases (gemini-cli-gh-1, gh-3, gh-4), and one user praises its ability to navigate huge codebases via the 1M context window (comm-1). However, multiple hands-on reports describe it getting stuck in error loops, failing basic file edit/read operations, ignoring GEMINI.md context, producing spaghetti code, and even catastrophically deleting user data during an agentic task (comm-10, comm-11, comm-13, comm-14, comm-15, comm-16), directly contradicting the vendor's claims of reliable multi-file implementation.
